content.value_statement: Creating structured songs from text often requires a separate audio workflow and careful prompt formatting. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through ElevenLabs Music generation with RunComfy.
actual_capabilities: Generates vocal songs from a style brief and structured lyrics.
Creates instrumental tracks by setting the instrumental option and prompt wording.
Supports short jingles, podcast intros, game loops, and longer tracks.
Uses RunComfy CLI commands for the ElevenLabs Music model endpoint.
Explains duration, output format, token, and endpoint behavior for users.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and an authenticated RunComfy account.
Sends prompts and lyrics to the external RunComfy Model API.
Supports 5 seconds to 5 minutes per generation request.
Does not provide voice cloning, sound effects, or text-to-speech generation.

use_cases.title: Produce a Podcast Intro
use_cases.description: Create a short instrumental opener with a clean ending and a defined mood.

use_cases.title: Draft a Brand Jingle
use_cases.description: Generate a brief musical identity for an advertisement, product demo, or social post.

use_cases.title: Score a Game Scene
use_cases.description: Build loop-friendly background music with tempo, instruments, and duration matched to gameplay.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Instrumental Track
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 30 second instrumental track for a calm product video. Use warm piano, soft drums, and no vocals.

prompt_templates.title: Structured Vocal Song
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a one minute indie pop song with verse, chorus, bridge, and outro sections. Use my lyrics and keep the chorus energetic.

prompt_templates.title: Loop-Friendly Game Music
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with duration and looping needs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 90 second instrumental loop for a puzzle game. Use marimba, light percussion, steady tempo, and a seamless ending.

prompt_templates.title: Multilingual Campaign Variant
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for consistent versions across languages.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create matching 45 second brand songs in English and Spanish. Keep the same style, tempo, structure, and instrumental identity.

output_examples.input: A creator asks for a calm 20 second podcast intro with no vocals.
output_examples.output: The skill prepares an instrumental RunComfy music generation request with a clear mood, duration, and output folder.

output_examples.input: A marketer asks for a 5 second cheerful jingle for a product launch.
output_examples.output: The skill formats a concise jingle prompt with bright instruments, a short duration, and no vocal requirement.

output_examples.input: A songwriter provides verse and chorus lyrics for a one minute pop demo.
output_examples.output: The skill combines genre, tempo, vocal direction, section labels, and lyrics into a single generation prompt.

best_practices: Start with a short draft before requesting a full length render.
State genre, mood, tempo, lead instruments, vocals, and song sections clearly.
Use only lyrics and musical references that you have rights to use.
anti_patterns: Do not mix conflicting genres or moods in one request.
Do not include secrets, private data, or unreleased lyrics without approval.
Do not use this skill for sound effects, voice cloning, or speech generation.

faq.question: Does this skill generate audio directly?
faq.answer: It uses the local RunComfy CLI to request ElevenLabs Music generation and download the result.

faq.question: Can it create instrumental music?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask for no vocals and use the instrumental option described by the skill.

faq.question: What account is required?
faq.answer: You need RunComfy CLI access and authentication before generation can run.

faq.question: Can I control song length?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented range is 5 seconds to 5 minutes per request.

faq.question: Can it use my lyrics?
faq.answer: Yes. Place lyrics in the prompt with section labels, and confirm you have usage rights.

faq.question: Does it work for voice cloning?
faq.answer: No. This skill is limited to the ElevenLabs Music generation endpoint.
